import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

const CourseCard = ({ course, onDetails, mobile }) => (
  <article
    onClick={() => onDetails(course)}
    style={{
      background: 'linear-gradient(145deg,#f4fbf9,#edf7f5)',
      border: '1px solid #dcebea',
      borderRadius: 14,
      padding: 14,
      minWidth: mobile ? '100%' : 0,
      display: 'flex',
      flexDirection: 'column',
      cursor: 'pointer',
      boxShadow: '0 5px 16px rgba(4,77,78,.06)',
      transition: 'all .25s ease'
    }}
  >
    <div
      style={{
        height: 145,
        background: '#fff',
        borderRadius: 11,
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        overflow: 'hidden',
        marginBottom: 12
      }}
    >
      <img
        src={course.image}
        alt={course.title}
        style={{
          width: '100%',
          height: '100%',
          objectFit: 'contain',
          padding: 10
        }}
      />
    </div>

    <div
      style={{
        display: 'flex',
        justifyContent: 'space-between',
        alignItems: 'flex-start',
        gap: 8
      }}
    >
      <h3
        style={{
          margin: 0,
          color: '#113c43',
          fontFamily: 'Georgia,serif',
          fontSize: 19,
          lineHeight: 1.15
        }}
      >
        {course.title}
      </h3>

      {course.badge && (
        <span
          style={{
            background: course.badge === 'New' ? '#efbe4b' : '#08706d',
            color: course.badge === 'New' ? '#163c42' : '#fff',
            borderRadius: 14,
            padding: '5px 9px',
            fontSize: 9,
            fontWeight: 800,
            whiteSpace: 'nowrap'
          }}
        >
          {course.badge}
        </span>
      )}
    </div>

    <p
      style={{
        color: '#596a70',
        fontSize: 12,
        lineHeight: 1.45,
        margin: '9px 0 10px'
      }}
    >
      {course.description}
    </p>

    <div
      style={{
        display: 'flex',
        gap: 6,
        overflowX: 'auto',
        paddingBottom: 8,
        scrollbarWidth: 'thin'
      }}
    >
      {course.topics.map((topic, i) => (
        <span
          key={i}
          style={{
            flexShrink: 0,
            background: '#fff',
            border: '1px solid #d4e6e3',
            borderRadius: 20,
            padding: '5px 9px',
            color: '#386066',
            fontSize: 10,
            fontWeight: 600
          }}
        >
          ✓ {topic}
        </span>
      ))}
    </div>

    <div
      style={{
        marginTop: 'auto',
        display: 'flex',
        justifyContent: 'space-between',
        alignItems: 'center',
        paddingTop: 9,
        color: '#173e44',
        fontSize: 11,
        fontWeight: 800
      }}
    >
      <span>◷ {course.duration}</span>
      <span>{course.level}</span>
    </div>

    <button
      onClick={e => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        onDetails(course);
      }}
      style={{
        width: '100%',
        border: 0,
        borderRadius: 23,
        background: '#075d5d',
        color: '#fff',
        height: 40,
        marginTop: 10,
        fontSize: 12,
        fontWeight: 800,
        cursor: 'pointer'
      }}
    >
      View Modules & Details →
    </button>
  </article>
);

const CourseModal = ({ course, onClose }) => {
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  useEffect(() => {
    const close = e => e.key === 'Escape' && onClose();
    document.addEventListener('keydown', close);
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('keydown', close);
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    };
  }, [onClose]);

  const enquire = () => {
    onClose();
    navigate('/contact');
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
  };

  return (
    <div
      onMouseDown={e =>
        e.target === e.currentTarget && onClose()
      }
      style={{
        position: 'fixed',
        inset: 0,
        zIndex: 9999,
        background: 'rgba(4,31,34,.75)',
        backdropFilter: 'blur(5px)',
        display: 'flex',
        alignItems: 'center',
        justifyContent: 'center',
        padding: 15
      }}
    >
      <div
        style={{
          width: 'min(850px,100%)',
          maxHeight: '92vh',
          overflowY: 'auto',
          background: '#fff',
          borderRadius: 18,
          boxShadow: '0 25px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.3)'
        }}
      >
        <div
          style={{
            padding: 23,
            background: 'linear-gradient(135deg,#075d5d,#0b7370)',
            color: '#fff',
            display: 'flex',
            justifyContent: 'space-between',
            gap: 15
          }}
        >
          <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 15 }}>
            <img
              src={course.image}
              alt={course.title}
              style={{
                width: 80,
                height: 80,
                objectFit: 'contain',
                background: '#fff',
                borderRadius: 10,
                padding: 7
              }}
            />

            <div>
              <h2
                style={{
                  margin: '3px 0 7px',
                  fontFamily: 'Georgia,serif',
                  fontSize: 27
                }}
              >
                {course.title}
              </h2>

              <p
                style={{
                  margin: 0,
                  color: '#e7f5f3',
                  fontSize: 12,
                  lineHeight: 1.5
                }}
              >
                {course.overview}
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            style={{
              width: 35,
              height: 35,
              border: 0,
              borderRadius: '50%',
              background: 'rgba(255,255,255,.18)',
              color: '#fff',
              fontSize: 23,
              cursor: 'pointer'
            }}
          >
            ×
          </button>
        </div>

        <div style={{ padding: 22 }}>
          <h3
            style={{
              color: '#075d5d',
              margin: '0 0 15px',
              fontSize: 18
            }}
          >
            Course Topics
          </h3>

          <div
            style={{
              display: 'flex',
              gap: 7,
              overflowX: 'auto',
              paddingBottom: 15
            }}
          >
            {course.topics.map((topic, i) => (
              <span
                key={i}
                style={{
                  flexShrink: 0,
                  background: '#f0f8f6',
                  border: '1px solid #d7e8e5',
                  borderRadius: 20,
                  padding: '7px 11px',
                  fontSize: 11,
                  color: '#315b60',
                  fontWeight: 700
                }}
              >
                ✓ {topic}
              </span>
            ))}
          </div>

          <h3
            style={{
              color: '#075d5d',
              margin: '15px 0',
              fontSize: 18
            }}
          >
            Course Curriculum — Module Wise
          </h3>

          <div style={{ display: 'grid', gap: 12 }}>
            {course.modules.map((module, index) => (
              <div
                key={index}
                style={{
                  border: '1px solid #dce9e7',
                  borderRadius: 12,
                  overflow: 'hidden',
                  background: '#fff'
                }}
              >
                <div
                  style={{
                    padding: '13px 15px',
                    background: '#f0f8f6',
                    color: '#075d5d',
                    fontWeight: 800,
                    fontSize: 14
                  }}
                >
                  {module.name}
                </div>

                <div
                  style={{
                    display: 'grid',
                    gridTemplateColumns:
                      'repeat(auto-fit,minmax(180px,1fr))',
                    gap: 8,
                    padding: 13
                  }}
                >
                  {module.content.map((item, i) => (
                    <div
                      key={i}
                      style={{
                        padding: '9px 11px',
                        borderRadius: 8,
                        background: '#fafdfc',
                        border: '1px solid #edf2f1',
                        color: '#52666b',
                        fontSize: 11.5
                      }}
                    >
                      <span style={{ color: '#08736e', fontWeight: 900 }}>
                        ✓
                      </span>{' '}
                      {item}
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          <div
            style={{
              display: 'grid',
              gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit,minmax(150px,1fr))',
              gap: 10,
              marginTop: 20
            }}
          >
            {[
              ['Duration', course.duration],
              ['Level', course.level],
              ['Training Mode', course.mode]
            ].map(([label, value]) => (
              <div
                key={label}
                style={{
                  border: '1px solid #dce9e7',
                  borderRadius: 10,
                  padding: 13
                }}
              >
                <div
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 9,
                    color: '#718084',
                    textTransform: 'uppercase',
                    letterSpacing: 1
                  }}
                >
                  {label}
                </div>

                <div
                  style={{
                    fontSize: 12,
                    color: '#173e44',
                    fontWeight: 800,
                    marginTop: 5
                  }}
                >
                  {value}
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        <div
          style={{
            padding: '5px 22px 22px',
            display: 'flex',
            gap: 10
          }}
        >
          <button
            onClick={enquire}
            style={{
              flex: 1,
              border: 0,
              background: '#075d5d',
              color: '#fff',
              height: 44,
              borderRadius: 23,
              fontSize: 12,
              fontWeight: 800,
              cursor: 'pointer'
            }}
          >
            Enquire Now →
          </button>

          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            style={{
              border: '1px solid #d4a63b',
              background: '#fff',
              color: '#23474c',
              height: 44,
              borderRadius: 23,
              padding: '0 25px',
              fontSize: 12,
              fontWeight: 800,
              cursor: 'pointer'
            }}
          >
            Close
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default function Courses() {
  const [selectedCourse, setSelectedCourse] = useState(null);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState('');
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState('All');
  const [mobile, setMobile] = useState(window.innerWidth <= 700);

  useEffect(() => {
    const resize = () => setMobile(window.innerWidth <= 700);
    window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', resize);
  }, []);

  const categories = [
    'All',
    ...new Set(courses.map(course => course.category))
  ];

  const filteredCourses = courses.filter(course => {
    const matchesSearch =
      course.title.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase()) ||
      course.topics.some(topic =>
        topic.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())
      );

    const matchesFilter =
      filter === 'All' || course.category === filter;

    return matchesSearch && matchesFilter;
  });

  return (
    <>
      <Header />

      <main
        style={{
          background: '#fff',
          color: '#153c43',
          fontFamily: 'Inter,Arial,sans-serif'
        }}
      >
        {/* HERO */}
        <section
          style={{
            minHeight: mobile ? 560 : 450,
            display: 'flex',
            alignItems: 'center',
            background:
              'linear-gradient(90deg,#034f51 0%,#075d5d 45%,rgba(5,75,76,.55) 100%),url("https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1497366754035-f200968a6e72?auto=format&fit=crop&w=1800&q=90") center/cover'
          }}
        >
          <div
            style={{
              width: 'min(1180px,calc(100% - 30px))',
              margin: 'auto'
            }}
          >
            <div style={{ maxWidth: 650 }}>
              <div
                style={{
                  color: '#fff',
                  fontSize: 11,
                  letterSpacing: 3,
                  fontWeight: 800,
                  marginBottom: 12
                }}
              >
                OUR COURSES
              </div>

              <h1
                style={{
                  fontFamily: 'Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif',
                  fontSize: mobile ? 40 : 56,
                  lineHeight: 1,
                  margin: 0,
                  color: '#fff'
                }}
              >
                Future-Ready
                <br />
                Skills for a
                <br />
                <span style={{ color: '#edbd50' }}>
                  Better Tomorrow
                </span>
              </h1>

              <p
                style={{
                  color: '#fff',
                  fontSize: 14,
                  lineHeight: 1.6,
                  maxWidth: 570,
                  margin: '17px 0 25px'
                }}
              >
                Industry-focused online courses designed to help
                you learn, build, and grow from anywhere in the world.
              </p>

              <div
                style={{
                  display: 'grid',
                  gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(4,1fr)',
                  maxWidth: 550,
                  gap: 5
                }}
              >
                {[
                  ['▣', 'Live Classes'],
                  ['♟', 'Expert Trainers'],
                  ['▤', 'Certification'],
                  ['▥', 'Placement Guidance']
                ].map(([icon, text]) => (
                  <div
                    key={text}
                    style={{
                      color: '#fff',
                      padding: 8,
                      borderRight: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3)'
                    }}
                  >
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 25 }}>{icon}</div>
                    <div style={{ fontSize: 10, fontWeight: 700 }}>
                      {text}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* COURSES */}
        <section
          style={{
            padding: '35px 0 45px'
          }}
        >
          <div
            style={{
              width: 'min(1180px,calc(100% - 30px))',
              margin: 'auto'
            }}
          >
            <div style={{ marginBottom: 25 }}>
              <div
                style={{
                  fontSize: 11,
                  fontWeight: 800,
                  letterSpacing: 3,
                  color: '#075d60',
                  marginBottom: 7
                }}
              >
                EXPLORE OUR COURSES
              </div>

              <h2
                style={{
                  fontFamily: 'Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif',
                  fontSize: mobile ? 32 : 43,
                  lineHeight: 1.1,
                  margin: 0,
                  color: '#103c43'
                }}
              >
                Choose Your{' '}
                <span style={{ color: '#bd8b25' }}>
                  Learning Path
                </span>
              </h2>
            </div>

            {/* SEARCH */}
            <div
              style={{
                display: 'flex',
                flexWrap: 'wrap',
                gap: 10,
                marginBottom: 18
              }}
            >
              <div
                style={{
                  flex: '1 1 300px',
                  position: 'relative'
                }}
              >
                <input
                  value={search}
                  onChange={e => setSearch(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="🔍 Search courses or topics..."
                  style={{
                    width: '100%',
                    height: 46,
                    border: '1px solid #d5e5e2',
                    borderRadius: 25,
                    padding: '0 18px',
                    outline: 'none',
                    fontSize: 13,
                    color: '#23474c',
                    background: '#f8fcfb'
                  }}
                />
              </div>

              <select
                value={filter}
                onChange={e => setFilter(e.target.value)}
                style={{
                  height: 46,
                  minWidth: 190,
                  border: '1px solid #d5e5e2',
                  borderRadius: 25,
                  padding: '0 18px',
                  outline: 'none',
                  fontSize: 12,
                  fontWeight: 700,
                  color: '#23474c',
                  background: '#f8fcfb'
                }}
              >
                {categories.map(category => (
                  <option key={category}>{category}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            {/* FILTER BUTTONS */}
            <div
              style={{
                display: 'flex',
                gap: 8,
                overflowX: 'auto',
                paddingBottom: 12,
                marginBottom: 15
              }}
            >
              {categories.map(category => (
                <button
                  key={category}
                  onClick={() => setFilter(category)}
                  style={{
                    flexShrink: 0,
                    border: 0,
                    borderRadius: 20,
                    padding: '9px 16px',
                    background:
                      filter === category ? '#075d5d' : '#edf7f5',
                    color:
                      filter === category ? '#fff' : '#315b60',
                    fontSize: 11,
                    fontWeight: 800,
                    cursor: 'pointer'
                  }}
                >
                  {category}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>

            {/* COURSE GRID */}
            {filteredCourses.length > 0 ? (
              <div
                style={{
                  display: 'grid',
                  gridTemplateColumns: mobile
                    ? '1fr'
                    : 'repeat(3,1fr)',
                  gap: 14
                }}
              >
                {filteredCourses.map((course, index) => (
                  <CourseCard
                    key={index}
                    course={course}
                    onDetails={setSelectedCourse}
                    mobile={mobile}
                  />
                ))}
              </div>
            ) : (
              <div
                style={{
                  textAlign: 'center',
                  padding: 50,
                  borderRadius: 15,
                  background: '#f4fbf9',
                  color: '#53676b'
                }}
              >
                <div style={{ fontSize: 35 }}>🔍</div>
                <h3>No courses found</h3>
                <p>Try another course name or category.</p>

                <button
                  onClick={() => {
                    setSearch('');
                    setFilter('All');
                  }}
                  style={{
                    border: 0,
                    background: '#075d5d',
                    color: '#fff',
                    borderRadius: 22,
                    padding: '11px 22px',
                    cursor: 'pointer'
                  }}
                >
                  View All Courses
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* BENEFITS */}
        <section style={{ padding: '0 0 40px' }}>
          <div
            style={{
              width: 'min(1180px,calc(100% - 30px))',
              margin: 'auto',
              border: '1px solid #dcebea',
              borderRadius: 25,
              padding: 15,
              boxShadow: '0 6px 20px rgba(0,75,77,.06)'
            }}
          >
            <div
              style={{
                display: 'grid',
                gridTemplateColumns: mobile
                  ? '1fr 1fr'
                  : 'repeat(4,1fr)',
                gap: 10
              }}
            >
              {[
                ['▱', '100% Online', 'Live Classes'],
                ['♟', 'Industry Experts', 'Expert Trainers'],
                ['▣', 'Get Certified', 'Showcase Your Skills'],
                ['▥', 'Build a Career', 'with Confidence']
              ].map(([icon, first, second]) => (
                <div
                  key={first}
                  style={{
                    display: 'flex',
                    alignItems: 'center',
                    gap: 9,
                    padding: 8
                  }}
                >
                  <div
                    style={{
                      fontSize: 26,
                      color: '#075e60'
                    }}
                  >
                    {icon}
                  </div>

                  <div
                    style={{
                      fontSize: 10,
                      lineHeight: 1.35,
                      color: '#29454a'
                    }}
                  >
                    <b>{first}</b>
                    <br />
                    {second}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>
      </main>

      <Footer />

      {selectedCourse && (
        <CourseModal
          course={selectedCourse}
          onClose={() => setSelectedCourse(null)}
        />
      )}
    </>
  );
}
